name.value: Aboriginal Journeys Wildlife and Adventure Tours

description.value: Aboriginal Journeys is the longest-running whale watching and grizzly bear viewing tour company in Campbell River, operating on Vancouver Island's coastal waters. Led by local Indigenous guides with decades of experience, guests sail the Salish Sea to spot orcas, humpback whales, and other marine wildlife, or observe grizzly bears from dedicated viewing platforms. The company is flagged as both LGBTQ2+ friendly and accessible on the Destination Indigenous platform.

address.value: 1434 Ironwood Street, Campbell River, British Columbia, V9W 5T5
